a.lede: Microsoft claims that it has made drastic improvements to the performance of Windows 11 while using 8GB of RAM.
a.title: Windows 11 8GB RAM configurations get a performance boost

b.lede: The developer's latest experiment takes Windows 11's hardware requirements to an extreme, managing to retain basic desktop functionality with just 128MB of memory, although the resulting installation is far too slow for everyday use.
b.title: Developer manages to run Windows 11 26H2 with just 128MB of RAM, just 3.1% of recommended minimum — stripped-down installation can access Desktop, File Explorer, and Notepad
